Bettina, I've saved the Monday digest job, but it won't post on its own yet, so please don't rely on it.

- **Schedule:** it's set for every Monday at 08:00. The scheduler is on UTC, though, so it will fire at 08:00 UTC, not 08:00 Chicago. I couldn't confirm it will fire at 08:00 Chicago time.
- **Not running yet:** the scheduler (Hermes gateway) is switched off, so nothing will fire until someone with admin access starts it.
- **Start date:** you asked for next Monday, which is 19 Oct. I couldn't confirm that date. The scheduler's own clock showed 26 Oct as the first run, and it doesn't follow the workspace clock.

When it does run, it reads only #coastal-team and #coastal-random, which have the same members as this channel. It posts one "Coastal week ahead" message here with two sections: last week's notable items, and open customer items. It leaves out finance figures unless they were already posted in those two channels.

If you want the 19 Oct digest on time, tell me and I'll post it by hand that morning.
